turn_input.text:
<execution-context>
execution_path=metaharness-driven
inner_harness=codex
workspace=metaharness-scratch
hermetic=strict
confinement=inner-harness
substrate=not-used-by-metaharness
decision_mode=frame
implication=metaharness applies the sealed frame before each mediated call
</execution-context>

state the workflow you are in

config:
# metaharness scratch CODEX_HOME for codex app-server. Generated per run; edited by
# nobody.

# The catalogue's tools are client tools metaharness serves and decides where each is
# called (item/tool/call, design amendment a66); code mode's tools reach nothing else.
# `never` keeps a vendor prompt nobody is there to answer from turning a call away first.
approval_policy = "never"

# The vendor's own floor beneath the seam, and Claude Code has no counterpart for it
# (design § 7.4, V17). It is **not** a constant: it is what the run's cwd declaration
# decides, because on this vendor the two are one setting.
#
# The cwd is scratch, so the child can write nothing at all: it reads, and the seam
# decides the rest.
sandbox_mode = "read-only"
personality = "pragmatic"

# The tools no environment gates, switched off: every one a config key reaches
# (design amendment a66 § 2).
web_search = "disabled"

# H5: the MCP surface is exactly what this launch gave, which is nothing.
[mcp_servers]

[tools.experimental_request_user_input]
enabled = false

[features]
goals = false
multi_agent = false
image_generation = false
apps = false
plugins = false
tool_suggest = false
sleep_tool = false

[agents]
enabled = false

[orchestrator.skills]
enabled = false
